display.purpose: Hero headers and high-impact editorial titles.

sans.purpose: Primary readable UI labels and dish descriptions.

mono.purpose: Prices, badges, toggle options, and numerical data.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Atmospheric depth for bottom sheet containers sliding up.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Smooth spring-like physics for modal drawers and pills.

components.name: Floating Cart Pill
components.description: Sticky bottom action bar displaying total item count and checkout price.
components.css: .ds-floating-pill { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; background: #FFD500; color: #1A1A1A; padding: 16px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-floating-pill:hover { transform: scale(1.02); }

components.name: Segmented View Switcher
components.description: Tab control inside navbar toggling between Editorial Canvas and Gallery views.
components.css: .ds-switcher { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(26,26,26,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(26,26,26,0.15); } .ds-switch-btn { padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; } .ds-switch-btn.ds-active { background: #FFD500; color: #1A1A1A; }

narrative.overview: Menú Digital encapsulates a high-end tactile dark-mode aesthetic for a Neo-Bistro venue. It balances publication-grade typography, tactile grain overlays, and fluid micro-interactions with immediate order conversion.
keyCharacteristics: Tactile dark background (#1A1A1A) with soft grain overlay
High-impact display font (Lilita One) paired with clean geometric sans (Rubik) and JetBrains Mono
Asymmetric Editorial Canvas vs. High-Density Grid view switcher
Direct WhatsApp checkout flow via split-screen drawers

rules.name: The Dark Surface Rule
rules.body: All primary views use charcoal dark background (#1A1A1A). Bright accents appear selectively on active interactive elements.

rules.name: The High Contrast Pill Rule
rules.body: Floating action bars and key interactive CTAs utilize vibrant mustard yellow (#FFD500) with dark text for maximum legibility.

dos: Do preserve mobile viewport boundaries with overflow-x clipping
Do use cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for fluid drawer and pill spring transitions
Do provide full keyboard accessibility with 2px mustard focus indicators
donts: Don't stretch margins horizontally beyond mobile viewport bounds
Don't mix generic browser default fonts with the defined Lilita One / Rubik / JetBrains Mono typography stack
